nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height). Default is 1 megapixel (1024*1024). For native 2K, set 1:1 and 4 megapixels (2048*2048). Prefer multiples of 32.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

---
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

---
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official  pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

widgets_values:
Dynamic prompts with enhancer

You need a loader. 
Local:
The prompt enhancer loader. (GGUF) is used when you have the prompt enhancing model in GGUF format installed locally on your comfy UI server in./models/LLM/.
Remote:
Use the prompt enhancer loader API when you have the model loaded in a LLM server somewhere like Ollama, or you are using a commercial API like Claude

In both cases, you need the system_prompt.txt file to be in ./models/LLM/.

This workflow is using Qwen2.1 but it could be adapted to any system. You just need to find a system prompt and prompt enhancer for that system and install it.

widgets_values:
USING CLAUDE AS YOUR PROMPT ENHANCER

1. API KEY
   Settings > Gadzoinks > LLM > "LLM API keys, named":
       anthropic=sk-ant-your-secret-key
   (Several keys: anthropic=...; openai=...)
   Keys never go on a node - node values are saved into workflows and images.

2. LOADER
   Use "Prompt Enhancer Loader (API, edit)" for image-to-image
   (or "Prompt Enhancer Loader (API)" for text-to-image):
       api           = Anthropic messages
       base_url      = (blank)
       model         = claude-haiku-4-5-20251001   (cheapest; plenty for this job)
       api_key_name  = anthropic
       system_prompt = must match the model type and task,
                       here: Qwen-Image 2.1 image-to-image (the ~18 KB one)
       thinking      = off

3. DYNAMIC PROMPTS WITH ENHANCER
   enhance = every run
       One Claude call per image; every prompt is written for its own values.
       "once, then substitute" makes a single call per batch (cheapest), but
       breaks when the rewrite rewords your choices (dinosaur -> sauropod).
   prefetch_next = auto (on for Claude)
       The next image's prompt is written while the current one renders,
       so you never wait for Claude. It costs one extra call per batch
       (4 images = 5 calls). For one or two images, set it to off.
       With the seed on randomize AND random { } blocks, prefetch guesses
       wrong and each miss is a wasted call - use off, or a fixed seed.

4. WHAT IT COSTS (Haiku 4.5, Qwen image-to-image, 1 reference image)
   Claude caches the system prompt + image for 5 minutes (refreshed on each use).
   The first call stores it, later calls read it at 1/10 of the price.

     first image of a batch (stores the cache) ... about $0.008
     each following image (cache reused) ........ about $0.0016

   Single image, prefetch off .............................. ~$0.008
   Single images queued one by one, less than 5 min apart .. $0.008 first,
                                                             then ~$0.0016 each
   Single images more than 5 min apart ..................... ~$0.008 each
   Batch of 20, every run, prefetch on (21 calls) .......... ~$0.04
   Batch of 20, every run, prefetch off (20 calls) ......... ~$0.038
   Batch of 20, once then substitute (1 call) .............. ~$0.008

   So 20 images cost about 4 cents; 1,000 images about $1.60.
   Real numbers: the console prints "prompt cache - N tokens reused ..." per
   call, and console.anthropic.com > Usage shows the actual bill.

   Text-to-image is cached only if the prompt is long enough (4,096+ tokens on
   Haiku). The short FLUX.2 prompt never is: ~$0.0023 per image, ~5 cents / 20.
